The '''''Vulture's Claw''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that belonged to the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]].

==History==
[[File:VulturesClawSalvage.png|thumb|left|180px|''Vulture's Claw'' searching the wreckage after the Battle of Bothawui]]
The ''Vulture's Claw'' was a [[GS-100 salvage ship/Legends|GS-100 salvage ship]] owned by a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] named [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]], who scoured hulking wrecks of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] left in the aftermath of [[Space warfare/Legends|space battles]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] for parts, [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and anything he could sell to the highest bidder. The ship had no problem defending itself from attackers, and Gha was able to catch opponents off guard long enough to get an advantage. It had a moderate defensive system with heavy arms delivery, yet the accuracy of the ship wasn't what enemies feared; it was its resilience. The ''Vulture's Claw'' was able to mitigate damage with its onboard [[Computer/Legends|computer]] and droid repair systems. Nachkt also hired himself out as a transport for [[Troop/Legends|troops]] or [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] in between salvage operations.

[[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], having been lost after the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]], later came into Nachkt's possession, who uncovered [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|military]] secrets within Artoo's memory. Realizing how much the secrets would be worth to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Nachkt attempted to sell them to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].

[[File:IG-86sVulturesClaw-TCWe06.png|thumb|left|180px|[[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droids]] activating in the hold of the ''Vulture's Claw'']]
[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], wearing simple [[Cloak/Legends|cloaks]] to avoid being recognized as [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], boarded the ship to look for R2-D2. While they were attempting to search through a cargo hold filled with [[Standard year/Legends|years']] worth of junk, Anakin's replacement [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]], [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]] tripped up their progress, thereby activating Gha's [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droids]]. Anakin, Ahsoka, and R3-S6 escaped the ''Vulture's Claw'' without recovering R2-D2.

Gha Nachkt took the ''Vulture's Claw'' to the CIS [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]] in orbit above [[Ruusan 2/Legends|Ruusan 2]] in order to deliver Artoo to General Grievous. Nachkt was killed by Grievous when he raised his fee for transferring Artoo over to the Separatists. The ''Vulture's Claw'' was presumably destroyed when Skytop Station was blown up by Republic operatives.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Vulture's Claw'' has seats similar in design to those found aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
